generation.noCredentials: Enter your API credentials to see your models.
generation.dropPicture: Drop an image, or paste its id
generation.dropModel: Drop a 3D model, or paste its id
generation.operationHint: What the generation will make of the workspace content
generation.noOperation: No operation is possible with what is selected.
generation.noModelForOperation: No model available for this operation.

models.pickOne: Nothing is billed until you pick a model.
models.planLockedHint: This model is not included in the {{plan}} plan. Generating with it would be refused.
models.engineMissingHint: No engine in this studio can open this model yet.
models.downloadThisHint: {{name}} — {{size}} fetched from its publisher. The studio redistributes nothing.
models.notInstalledHint: The weights are not on this machine. Click to fetch them from their publisher.

auth.explanation: Your credentials are encrypted by the system keychain and never leave your machine.
auth.configureHint: Opens the settings, at the account section

accounts.name: Name
accounts.none: No account yet. Add an API key.
accounts.switchHint: Pick the API key to use, or add one
accounts.scopeApp: No project open — this choice holds for the studio
accounts.explanation: Switching accounts changes the service in use — never your local files.

errors.duplicate: Another account already uses this name.
errors.store-unreadable: The keychain did not give your accounts back. Try again once it is unlocked — nothing was changed.
errors.unexpected: The account could not be saved.

accounts.useHint: This key will be the one this service uses
accounts.renameHint: Changes only the name shown here — the key itself stays the same
accounts.removeHint: Forgets the key on this machine; the remote account is untouched
accounts.saveHint: Keeps the new name, provided no other account already has it
accounts.cancelHint: Leaves the name as it was
accounts.addHint: Stores the key, encrypted by the system keychain
accounts.manageHint: Opens the settings to add, rename or remove an account

intents.skyboxSourceHint: Opens the skybox document and sets this image as the panorama source
intents.sceneMeshHint: Opens the 3D scene and adds the model to it
intents.sceneAnimationHint: Lays this motion on the character selected in the scene
intents.audioTakeHint: Opens the audio editor and loads this take into it
intents.imageLayerHint: Opens the image document and lays the asset in as a new layer
intents.videoClipHint: Opens the edit and adds the asset to it as a clip
intents.textureChannelHint: Opens the texture document and fills its base colour channel
